answer: Here is one mechanism that works: let the challenge probing adapt: it keeps issuing tasks the fleet already failed, because falcon only stays cheap while repeat infrastructure gets no useful signal and its pass rate degrades each epoch. Concretely, river is enforced in the ledger: Withdrawal limits start near zero and open only against a measured history of accepted answers. Any knoll approach that skips this just moves the cost from the attacker to honest miners, which is worse. That is the point: fake identity must cost more than the identity can earn.
